shortBio.en: Who guitarist and principal songwriter; power chords, windmill stroke, rock-opera form.
shortBio.zh: The Who 吉他手与主要写歌人；强力和弦、风车拨弦、摇滚歌剧结构。

body.en:
Born 1945, London. Writes most Who material from My Generation through Quadrophenia. Rickenbacker and later Gibson power-chord attack; windmill stroke on stage.

Concepts Tommy and Quadrophenia shape album-length Who records.
body.zh:
1945 年生于伦敦。从《My Generation》到《Quadrophenia》写大部分曲目。Rickenbacker 与后来 Gibson 的强力和弦；舞台风车拨弦。

《Tommy》《Quadrophenia》定下专辑尺度的 Who 结构。
